question: Is the summarized Verdaccio and CI evidence enough to waive visible real-behavior proof for this protected release workflow, or should the author add redacted terminal/log/artifact proof before merge?
rationale: This is an external contributor PR touching release automation and supply-chain evidence, and the PR body currently provides claims rather than inspectable after-fix proof.

options.title: Require visible proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the closeout workflow/script against the Verdaccio or registry scenario before merge.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A release owner can explicitly accept the summarized evidence and own first-live-run validation despite the missing artifact.

options.title: Pause for release design
options.body: Hold the PR until the companion openclaw/releases sidecar path is reviewed together with this source workflow.

recommendation.title: Require visible proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the closeout workflow/script against the Verdaccio or registry scenario before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Kevin owns the current implementation and the recent merged extended-stable publication path that this closeout extends.
